law.citation: GeoNames holds Mambéré, Ouham-Fafa and Lim-Pendé as first-level divisions of the Central African Republic, beside Mambéré-Kadéï, Ouham and Ouham-Pendé, the prefectures they were formed from.

units.citation: Wikidata, this prefecture's item, read on 2026-11-28: English label and item id, and the ISO 3166-2 code where the item holds one. The GeoNames id is the prefecture's row in the GeoNames country file.

membership.citation: Each sub-prefecture record is assigned to the prefecture that GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-28. For each of the 20 records, at least 96 percent of those places are under one prefecture.
